this mod is a faithful continuation of the original public domain [windchimes mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/windchimes) made by [hibi](https://modrinth.com/user/hibi).

the goal of this project is to keep the original mod's content updated for modern minecraft versions on both fabric & neoforge.
